behavior: observeNextAction reads every goal (parents, dependencies, deadline, health, order, latest progress), open work and work settled in the last 7 days, open commitments that are not work items, and the readiness of each workflow version open work runs. It writes nothing.

planNextAction is a pure function of that snapshot. Candidates rank in a stated order: check a finished result, resolve a blocker, restore what accepted work needs, decide a proposal, continue accepted work, start an unblocked goal step, review a goal; within a kind by deadline, health, goal order and age.
Doing nothing new is always weighed; it wins when open items reach capacity (default 5) and the best option adds work, or when nothing achievable remains.

Guards: no step behind an unmet dependency or inactive goal or parent; no step duplicating an open commitment or work item (titles compared ignoring case and punctuation); no repeat of work checked done in the last 7 days; stale goals (14 days without progress or work, or escalation suggesting a stop) get a review prompt.
It asks instead of guessing when a goal above task level has no task, when the last attempt failed its check, or when two goals' new steps have nothing (deadline, health, order) between them.

Each result carries the goal and revision, the goal path, evidence references, a rationale against doing nothing and the runner-up, the work item to link or null, an expiry (12 hours or the goal deadline) and a basis digest of every input except the clock; considered lists every alternative and why it lost or was left out.

rollback: Revert the Q-18 commits. Nothing references the new module.
limitations: Signals are structured only: goals, work items, commitments, checked results and workflow readiness. Calendar, mail and facts are not read.
New steps come from the user's own goal titles; a missing step is asked for, never invented.
Plain commitments count toward the workload and guard against duplicates but are not recommended; F-13 links work items.
Duplicates are matched on normalized titles; a reworded duplicate is not caught.
The ranking is a stated preference order, not a measured optimum; the scenarios and rubric await founder review.
found: The morning plan reads active and overdue goals and yesterday's review summary, but not dependencies, open work or checked results. It never deduplicates against existing commitments and writes its actions straight into work items. Q-18 does not change it; F-13 decides whether What's next? replaces it.
